name: +1 Money Roll To Get Rich
desc:
💸 Welcome to +1 Money Roll To Get Rich! 💸
💰 Every roll earns you more Money
🏃 Roll through challenging stages and collect as much Cash as possible
🐾 Hatch powerful pets to increase your multipliers
✨ Unlock auras, training zones, boosts, and better cash stands
👥 Compete against friends and other players
🏆 Earn Wins and become the RICHEST player on the server
🚀 Keep rolling… but lose your money and you’re back at the start! 😱
